episodes.title: Go West, Old Man
episodes.summary: Dwight, blindsided by the news that his mob family has nothing left for him in New York, is sent to Tulsa, Oklahoma. As he settles in and surveys his new surroundings, Dwight wastes no time making new associates.

episodes.title: Center of the Universe
episodes.summary: Dwight, Tyson, and Bodhi go on a road trip to take care of some business; Stacy does some digging into Dwight's past.

episodes.title: Caprice
episodes.summary: Dwight takes note of a possible new business opportunity. Later, a routine errand has an explosive, unexpected outcome. Stacy opens up to Dwight about what led her to Tulsa.

episodes.title: Visitation Place
episodes.summary: At the Tulsa Arena, Dwight and company test out their new plan, until a roadblock forces them to adjust and defend their turf. Tyson and his father argue about his future. Dwight gets an unexpected call.

episodes.title: Token Joe
episodes.summary: Dwight returns to New York under unfortunate circumstances, where his reunion with his daughter and family doesn't go quite as expected. Back in Tulsa, Tyson runs into some trouble. Armand gets some news from Roxy.

episodes.title: Stable
episodes.summary: Dwight visits Tina before returning to Tulsa. Pete agrees to send Goodie to Oklahoma, while Roxy tries to keep the FBI at bay. Dwight has an offer for Mitch.

episodes.title: Warr Acres
episodes.summary: Stacy makes a decision that has serious consequences. Dwight and Armand dispose of evidence, and Bodhi proposes a new plan. Tina contemplates her future.

episodes.title: Adobe Walls
episodes.summary: Dwight and Bodhi lay out the casino plan for Jimmy. As pressure increases, Dwight, Mitch, and Tyson assemble their team. Stacy confronts Waltrip.

episodes.title: Happy Trails
episodes.summary: It's all hands on deck as tensions between Dwight's crew and Waltrip escalate past the point of no return. Elsewhere, a flashback reveals what sent Dwight to prison 25 years ago.

episodes.title: Back in the Saddle
episodes.summary: As Dwight and his crew prepare for the opening of their casino and new weed shop, the law comes knocking.

episodes.title: Kansas City Blues
episodes.summary: A family member from Dwight's past surprises him in Tulsa, meanwhile his newfound success draws attention from the Kansas City Mob.

episodes.title: Oklahoma v. Manfredi
episodes.summary: Dwight has a contentious meeting with Bill Bevilaqua and later finds out his fate in court.

episodes.title: Heroes and Villains
episodes.summary: Dwight and Bodhi explore a new investment opportunity. Meanwhile, Thresher learns how far he can push certain people.

episodes.title: Tilting at Windmills
episodes.summary: Thresher makes a move on Dwight's crew as tensions rise within the New York City Mob family.

episodes.title: Navigator
episodes.summary: Dwight has a sit-down with Kansas City and New York. Tyson tries to make his family proud but it comes at a price.

episodes.title: Life Support
episodes.summary: Dwight and his crew try to identify who's responsible for the recent attack. Power dynamics within the NYC Mob start to shift.

episodes.title: Under New Management
episodes.summary: Bevilaqua prepares for revenge. Thresher and Ming discuss a new arrangement.

episodes.title: Triad
episodes.summary: Margaret gets caught up in the middle of Dwight's business as trouble ensues at Fennario Ranch.

episodes.title: Reconstruction
episodes.summary: Dwight and his crew tie up loose ends as their empire expands.

episodes.title: Blood and Bourbon
episodes.summary: Dwight tries to secure a distillery deal. Season premiere.

episodes.title: The Fifty
episodes.summary: Dwight faces threats from Jeremiah Dunmire and the Dixie Mafia.

episodes.title: The G and the OG
episodes.summary: Dwight is forced to work with Agent Musso to take down a terrorist.

episodes.title: Staring Down the Barrel
episodes.summary: Dwight rallies his crew to recover the stolen bourbon from Dunmire.

episodes.title: On the Rocks
episodes.summary: Dwight launches his bourbon brand as Dunmire schemes to crash the event.

episodes.title: Bubbles
episodes.summary: Dwight scrambles while facing threats from Dunmire and Quiet Ray.

episodes.title: Art of War
episodes.summary: Dwight moves to reopen his distillery. Tyson, Goodie & Spencer run a sting.

episodes.title: Nothing Is Over
episodes.summary: Dwight uncovers a deadly plan by Dunmire and races to stop it.

episodes.title: Dead Weight
episodes.summary: As Dwight expands his liquor empire, Tyson's side hustle draws heat.

episodes.title: Jesus Lizard
episodes.summary: Dwight and his crew gear up for all-out war.

episodes.title: W.W.D.D.
episodes.summary: As Dwight leads his crew toward legitimacy\u2014striking deals and expanding their empire\u2014his world abruptly fractures. Season premiere.

episodes.title: Blind Rooster
episodes.summary: Reeling from a crushing personal loss, Dwight leans on Bodhi's unexpected honesty as his crew faces fallout from Tyson's tainted pills.

episodes.title: Cease & Desist
episodes.summary: Dwight rallies the troops to fight back as Governor Clark shuts down his businesses, freezes bourbon shipments, and targets his crew.

episodes.title: Episode 10 (Season Finale)
episodes.summary: Season Finale.
